description:
Disable battery optimization for the Flight Crew View app (com.robert.fcView) to ensure reliable background notifications. 

Starting from the app's home screen, you must:
1. Navigate to Android System Settings.
2. Find 'Flight Crew View' in the Apps list.
3. Change its Battery usage setting from 'Optimized' to 'Unrestricted' (or add it to the 'Not Optimized' whitelist).

This is required because the default 'Optimized' state prevents the app from checking for flight updates in the background.
